guidance: Static compiler findings describe the program. Finding order and confidence do not rank performance benefit. For a port, establish the oracle's native instruction mix, intended-machine performance, and data reuse policy. For a novel kernel, count compulsory bytes and useful operations and measure matched primitives on the intended partition. Bound the end-to-end opportunity. An unexplained large oracle gap stops local tuning.
